Heavyweight Hoodie

$45.50

A clean, modern classic. This heavyweight pullover hoodie features an oversized fit with dropped shoulders and no drawcord for a minimal, deconstructed look. Made from a soft yet durable 10oz fleece, it’s finished with a dark brown embroidered Counter Culture logo on the chest and a woven logo tag at the front left waist. Super cozy and perfectly suited for slow mornings and chilly days.

  • Sizes S - 3XL
  • 10 oz (330 gm) cotton/polyester blend 3-end fleece
  • 70% Ring-spun Cotton / 30% Polyester
  • Boxy fit with drop shoulder
  • No drawcord
  • Blindstitch sewing on all seams for an understated, simplified design
  • Sewn woven label on waistband
  • Hoodie made by Independent Trading Co and embroidered by Durham-based Inkfinity Printing
